scope: 19 identified original UI image/glyph families in MAIN sections 2,3,4,6 only. Unreferenced ranges are preserved. No UI composition, text layout, input/HUD logic, terrain masks or actual DOS execution certification.
pixel_encoding: One byte per row-major pixel: opaque local index 0..15, or canonical transparent 0x80. Stored zero is opaque for background/skill panel/panel letters; zero is transparent for other supported families.
palette_policy: Return unchanged local indices and Menu/Level/Monochrome roles; no palette data or RGB conversion in library. Caller chooses palette; actual TS RGB was checked with pinned menu colors, a unique diagnostic level palette, and monochrome white.
verification: Rust and independent Python DAT/whole-plane-bit-string decoding agree for all 200 images/216192 index/opacity pixels and metadata. Actual pinned TS high-level getters cover 72 images; the remaining 128 use pinned TS planar/frame code with Lemmix layouts. All actual TS RGB/opacity values match.
reference_differences: TS MainImageSprites exposes only the first of each 16-frame scroll sequence and no rating-sign or menu-font reader; support the full pinned Lemmix layout.
TS creates a filled space glyph and a white 9x8 empty counter; these are generated UI state, not stored images, so they are not supplied by this resource API.
No new pixel differences within the supported policies. Keep palette assembly/scaling and UI composition separate.
